extension.description: Öffnet ein eigenes Prozessinformationen-Fenster. Dieses enthält Codec-, Video- und Audio-Details zum aktuell abgespielten Medium.
Opens a separate process information window. This window displays codec, video, and audio details for the currently playing media.
Megnyit egy külön saját lejátszófolyamat infó ablakot. Ez az ablak az éppen lejátszott média, kodek- videó- ​​hang- és egyéb adatait jeleníti meg.
extension.news: v1.3.6.8 - Wired the Theme color engine into the overlay skin: title, section icons, field labels, data values, filename, progress bars and the Modern background now follow the Theme settings. Default settings reproduce the original look; codec logo icons are unchanged. v1.3.6.7 - Added the Theme color engine: 12 customisable overlay colors (background, title, filename, header, icon, chart, description, output, FPS, progress, accent, unit) with 50 presets each plus custom HEX input and a reset action. Skin color wiring to be applied separately.
